import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_feather(''turbos.feather'')

# Test de cohérence rapide sur 5 entrées aléatoires
import random
sample_indices = random.sample(range(len(df)), 5)
all_consistent = True

for idx in sample_indices:
    row = df.iloc[idx]
    if row[''id_photo_gagnante''] != '''':
        winner = row[''id_photo_gagnante'']
        p1 = row[''id_photo1'']
        p2 = row[''id_photo2'']
        if winner != p1 and winner != p2:
            all_consistent = False
            break

print(f''🔍 Test cohérence sur échantillon: {\""✅ Toutes cohérentes\"" if all_consistent else \""❌ Incohérences détectées\""}'')
